bagPolicy.summary: For quick entry, fans are encouraged to leave bags at home. Small clutches, crossbody bags, and clear bags are allowed, while standard backpacks are not permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Purses, medical bags, and diaper bags are allowed if they meet NBA size requirements of 14” x 14” x 6” and will undergo additional screening.

parking.note: Valet parking starts 2 hours before events, and the garage opens a few hours prior. The venue has a five-story, 700-space parking structure for convenient parking.

rideshare.note: Lyft drop-off options include the plaza at 1st Street and Jefferson Street, The Ryan on South 2nd Street, and the Convention Center on South 3rd Street. For pickup, use South 3rd Street and East Jefferson Street by the Convention Center.

concessions.note: The Mortgage Matchup Center offers a variety of food and beverage options to cater to different dietary preferences, including vegetarian and gluten-free choices. While specific vendors are not listed, the venue promises a diverse selection to enhance the event experience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you have difficulty navigating stairs but do not need a wheelchair accessible location, row 20 in the 100 level and row 2 in the 200 level do not require taking stairs. Accessible parking spaces are located on floors 1-5 near elevators, available as first-come, first-served.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted for any games, concerts, or events at Mortgage Matchup Center.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Mortgage Matchup Center Ticket Office is located in the Pavilion on the Northwest side of the facility at 201 East Jefferson, Phoenix, AZ 85004 (corner of 1st Street & Jefferson). The Mortgage Matchup Center ticket office will be open at 3pm on weekday events and three (3) hours prior to event time for weekends.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Mortgage Matchup Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
